title: Static Five Lunule and Petaloid Sand Dollar Test
description: One wholly newly authored stylized dry sand-dollar test exterior at approximately ten-centimetre natural scale. The complete low domed circular-oval body has a fine continuous rim, five genuine elongated through-lunule tunnels arranged as two paired fields and one posterior field, and a shallow central oral-side recess. Five subtle attached low-relief petaloid outlines occupy the upper centre. All test surface triangles, tunnel walls, low dome and relief domains are new; no old spined urchin was stripped, flattened, recoloured or reused. One whole static nature prop, zero scenes, two opaque matte mineral-white PBR roles. This is a schematic dry-test exterior, not a living animal or an exact genus/species identification. The interior is simplified as solid wall material between openings, without microscopic pore counts, internal skeletal plates, lantern teeth or soft tissues. No collection, handling, habitat, hydrodynamic, biological function or physical-stability claim. No rig, animation or interaction made or verified.
